method: Editorial multi-label classification of the existing static findings. Confirmed findings mark explicitly referenced records incorrect. No implicit positive verdict and no propagation to backup core duplicates. Ordinary wrong model keys alone do not establish PRT logic defects.

findings.notes: Count the singular random generator as confirmed. The native effect of unguarded student-matrix inversion in PRT feedback remains pending, so exclude that PRT mechanism from confirmed PRT statistics.
Incompatible products are explicitly intended by the prompt; unconditional teacher-product evaluation and the absent none branch require native initialization verification. Kept undecided.
The unconditional none key has a fixed-point counterexample without an initial-value restriction; count the stated formulation/completeness defect as confirmed.
Both sources share the confirmed missing-positive-period definition error. The cycloid interpretation is a separate clarification.
